explication: Local Path Provisioner is a Kubernetes storage provisioner that creates hostPath- or local-backed persistent volumes using paths configured for each node or storage class. The user submits a PVC and workload; Kubernetes coordinates provisioning, after which the workload can use the bound volume. The daemon loads configuration, runs the provisioner, and uses helper pods to perform volume setup and cleanup. The README also documents shared-filesystem and custom helper-command options. Edges reflect README statements or shown source calls; where runtime dispatch is not shown, the link is marked unverified.
